observed_source_facts: The official Qwen3-TTS README at the pinned source revision labels the released 12Hz 0.6B and 1.7B models as Streaming-capable and describes a dual-track hybrid streaming architecture.
The official technical report states that the 12Hz tokenizer/model architecture supports immediate first-packet emission with reported end-to-end synthesis latency as low as 97 ms.
The official 0.6B and 1.7B model cards include German among the ten supported languages.

The official repository quickstart exposes generate_custom_voice, generate_voice_design and generate_voice_clone style calls that return generated waveforms; repository search at the pinned head did not surface a documented stream_generate-style API.

Therefore model-level streaming capability is source-supported, while a currently exposed official local incremental-audio API suitable for Frankenstein cancellation/barge-in is not established by this source audit.
architecture_consequence: Do not use the upstream 97 ms model claim as Frankenstein first-audible latency. The existing T7-TTS-001 0.6B-vs-1.7B target benchmark must explicitly record API/runtime identity, first actual PCM chunk time, chunk cadence, cancellation drain behavior, and unheard-audio suppression. A separate streaming runtime/fork may be benchmarked only as a distinct provenance-controlled challenger.
counterhypothesis_status: NOT_CONFIRMED: no official incremental stream_generate-style public API was identified at the pinned repository head, but absence from this audit is not proof that no supported serving path exists elsewhere.
next_exact_action: Keep T7-TTS-001 queued behind valid clay-direct-dev hardware headroom. On target execution, compare official qwen-tts/vLLM-supported path and any separately pinned streaming challenger under identical German prompts, measuring first emitted PCM, first audible audio, RTF, p95 chunk gaps, cancellation-to-silence latency, residual unheard audio, RAM/VRAM and long-turn prosody. Do not infer target latency from 97 ms upstream architecture evidence.
